# Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette

> > Regional news source covering Arkansas politics, elections, local news, and sports in Northwest Arkansas and statewide.

The Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette is the leading news organization for Northwest Arkansas and the state, featuring comprehensive coverage of Arkansas elections, state government, University of Arkansas Razorbacks sports, and regional business including Walmart. The site includes columnists like Wally Hall, John Brummett, Mike Masterson, and other prominent Arkansas journalists.

## Key Topics

- Arkansas elections and politics
- Northwest Arkansas regional news
- University of Arkansas Razorbacks
- State legislature and government
- Walmart and regional business
- Voter information and election results
- Local breaking news
- Arkansas Supreme Court
- Town halls and political events
- Columnists: Wally Hall, John Brummett, Mike Masterson, Art Hobson
- Live video coverage
- State House and gubernatorial races
- Bentonville and Springdale coverage

- [Governor | Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette](https://www.nwaonline.com/2022primargov): 2022 Arkansas gubernatorial primary election results and coverage
- [Lieutenant Governor | Lieutenant Governor | Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette](https://www.nwaonline.com/ballot2022generallieutenantgovernornw): 2022 Arkansas Lieutenant Governor race results and voter guide
- [Secretary of State | Secretary of State | Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette](https://www.nwaonline.com/ballot2022generalsecretaryofstate): 2022 Arkansas Secretary of State election results and coverage
- [Arkansas Supreme Court Chief Justice | Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette](https://www.nwaonline.com/2024chiefjustice): Arkansas Supreme Court Chief Justice election coverage
